title: Younglings on Ilum
description: Before becoming Padawan learners in the Jedi training process, children being groomed for future service were designated as Younglings. Divided into ten clans made up of twenty of their level, they underwent various rites of passage under the watchful eyes of Jedi elders, with Yoda himself taking a profound interest in their education and progress. One such rite was "The Gathering," where Younglings refined budding skills by harvesting kyber crystals for their Lightsabers on the distant world of Ilum.
